description_en: Creates an AccessKey pair for a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 调用CreateAccessKey接口为RAM用户创建访问密钥
name: CreateAccessKey

parameters.description_en: The name of the RAM user. If a RAM user calls this operation and does not specify this parameter, an AccessKey pair is created for the RAM user.
parameters.description_zh: 指定用户名，RAM用户调用此接口时，默认为自己创建访问密钥。
parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM user. If a RAM user calls this operation and does not specify this parameter, an AccessKey pair is created for the RAM user
parameters.help_zh: 指定用户名，RAM用户调用此接口时，默认为自己创建访问密钥
parameters.name: user_name
